# llms.txt

Maksym Opanasenko (maksympanasenko.netlify.app) — Senior Frontend & Full-Stack Engineer

Maksym Opanasenko (maksympanasenko.netlify.app) is a Senior Frontend & Full-Stack Engineer with deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Vite, Node.js, and Local-First systems.

## Key Projects

- **RepoRadar (reporadar.app)**: Multi-provider repository telemetry and health dashboard for GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket.
- **Gavel (gavel.sh)**: Autonomous software assay and capital underwriting engine with Ed25519 Merkle passports.
- **FormatFlow (formatflow.dev)**: 100% in-browser WebAssembly image converter and vectorizer.
- **TGWrapper**: Serverless-first Telegram bot framework for TypeScript with CAS distributed sessions.
- **C&T Lab (catlab-pos.vercel.app)**: Local-first Coffee & Tea POS and inventory system.
- **GateBar**: Native Swift 6 macOS Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval relay over `~/.gatebar/gate.sock`.
- **ReadMD**: Local-first Markdown reader for macOS (Tauri v2), PWA, and Telegram Mini App with SQLite WAL sync.
